name: SKA-Mid
place: Meerkat National Park, Karoo, Northern Cape
description: The mid-frequency half of the Square Kilometre Array, about 200 dishes covering 350 MHz to 14 GHz, being built in South Africa's Karoo.
highlights: Construction began on 5 December 2022 and the first receiver was placed in 2025.
It will incorporate the 64 MeerKAT dishes plus 133 new ones, 197 in total.
The SKA Observatory is headquartered at Jodrell Bank in England.
